news.title: Costa Rica appoint former captain Ruiz as head coach
news.lede: Soccer Football - FIFA World Cup Qatar 2022 - Costa Rica Press Conference - Main Media Center, Doha, Qatar - November 22, 2022 Costa Rica's Bryan Ruiz during the press conference REUTERS/John Sibley/File Photo. Oct 21 - Costa Rica have appointed former captain Bryan Ruiz as head coach to lead the national team's campaign to qualify for the 2030 World Cup, the Costa Rican Football Federation (FCRF) said on Wednesday. • Ruiz, 41, takes the job after two wins as interim coach, with Costa Rica beating Nicaragua 3-0 and Haiti 2-0 in the CONCACAF Nations League earlier this month. • He succeeds Argentine Fernando Batista, who was dismissed in September, while Costa Rica missed out on the 2026 World Cup under former coach Miguel Herrera.

news.title: Nigeria beat Puerto Rico to revive U17 World Cup hopes
news.lede: Oluwakemi Adegbuyi broke the deadlock in the 25th minute before substitute Precious Oscar sealed the victory three minutes into stoppage time. The Flamingos dominated proceedings but struggled to convert several opportunities, with Queen Joseph, captain Chidera Chidi and Tosin Rafiu all failing to find the target. Adegbuyi also came close to doubling her tally, while Puerto Rico threatened through Mia Colon, Megan Rivera and Caroline Rivera. The victory revived Nigeria's qualification hopes following their 2-1 defeat to Poland.

news.title: Ghana miss U17 World Cup after WAFU B semi-final loss to Ivory Coast
news.lede: The defeat at the 4th August Stadium in Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso, ends Ghana's hopes of reaching next year's continental tournament, which will be hosted by Morocco. Ghana's task became more difficult in the 18th minute when Daniel Owusu was sent off, leaving the Black Starlets to play the majority of the contest with 10 men. Despite the numerical disadvantage, Kassim Ocansey’s side showed resilience and managed to keep the Ivorians at bay for much of the encounter. However, Ivory Coast eventually broke the deadlock in the 77th minute, scoring the only goal of the match to secure their place in the final and qualification for the 2027 U17 AFCON.

news.title: Turkiye replace coach after poor results in Nations League, World Cup
news.lede: Former Turkiye international and Besiktas coach has been brought in to replace Vincenzo Montella in the Crescent Stars hot seat. Türkiye have appointed Sergen Yalcin as new coach, the Türkiye Football Federation (TFF) announced on Tuesday. The former Turkiye midfielder, 53, replaces Vincenzo Montella, who recently departed the role following a series of poor results in the recent international window. Turkiye lost all four of their UEFA Nations League games, including two defeats to Italy plus a 1-0 loss to France and 3-0 reverse in Belgium.
